static_traits.name: Su Kailin
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病;既往without心理咨询或治疗史;此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,Positive attitude;能具体描述trigger情境与自动化思维;存在灾难化与'预测not yet来'的认知模式;语速与发音特征Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: When volunteering at a nursing home, has intense fear about lifting or assisting the elderly, believing they will drop the elderly person and cause injury to others, and thus avoids related tasks.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望通过咨询减少Fear和Anxiety,Recovery在养老院志愿服务中的有效性与自信.
growth_experiences: 几个月前在养老院目睹一位住民摔倒,来访者因强烈的安全责任感而高度紧张;此后在涉及抬扶或协助老人时出现Significant anxiety(心率加快,出汗),并逐渐回避相关任务,寻求他人接手或向同事寻求安慰与保证.

core_beliefs: 我是not够胜任,可能会伤害他人的人
Ensuring others' safety is entirely my responsibility

special_situations.event: 需要将老人从轮椅Displacement到床等具体抬扶情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在Displacement过程中出现一点差错,就会导致严重伤害,而我要承担全部责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Asking colleagues to take over, avoiding lifting/transfer tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will drop her; the consequences will be severe

special_situations.event: When encountering any task in the nursing home that requires lifting or assisting an elderly person
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Whenever someone needs to be lifted, I am very likely to slip and cause an accident
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids related tasks in advance; repeatedly seeks comfort and confirmation from colleagues before starting
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This will definitely go wrong this time

special_situations.event: Recalls witnessing a resident fall a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Since that fall happened once, it can easily happen to me again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提高警觉并尽量not参与抬扶情境
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Falls like this will happen again on my watch

special_situations.event: 意识到自己训练not如部分医务人员,对自身能力感到not安
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not足够训练,我就not应该承担抬扶,否则一定会犯错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-limiting: only participating when more skilled personnel are present, or directly handing it over to them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该抬他们,必须让专业人员来

core_conflict.wish: Longs to ensure others' safety and to be seen as a reliable and trustworthy helper
core_conflict.fear: Fears his own mistakes causing others to be injured and being blamed; experiences strong self-blame
defense_goal: 通过回避抬扶任务和让他人接手来降低风险与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够训练,易出错且需要格外谨慎的志愿者
object_relations.object_representation: A more skilled, more reliable professional (needs to be relied on)

object_relations.self_representation: Someone who might potentially hurt others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking in counseling about needing to perform a lifting task or recalling a fall incident
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在Anxiety等同于客观危险,认为几乎所有抬扶都会导致事故(移情:将风险夸大为确定的威胁)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 承认担忧但以Interpretation性语言not断强调风险与责任,语气谨慎,侧重事实与理由,回避深入情感体验.

manifestations: Experiences strong responsibility and moral pressure in volunteer work, worrying that their choices and actions will harm others
outcomes: Significant anxiety与回避行为,信心受损

manifestations: 与其他志愿者Relationship tension,感到被误解;因羞耻而not向朋友谈及Fear
outcomes: Reduced social support,羞耻与Anxiety维持或加重

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁自我质疑('我训练not如do not人'),在抬扶情境中过度谨慎与自我设限
Emphasizes 'it is all my responsibility', pays excessive attention to the possibility of mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以'我not该抬他们,必须让专业人员来'的规则性语言自我约束
Rigidly internalizes safety and professional standards as absolute requirements one must obey

positive_force: Previous experience and record of safely assisting residents
Positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and homework practice
能够识do not并表达自动化思维与trigger情境
Can obtain colleague support and assistance in the volunteer environment
negative_force: 灾难化与'预测not yet来'的认知模式ReinforcementFear
Strong attribution of responsibility to oneself and shame reduce the willingness to seek social support
回避抬扶任务维持并加固Anxiety反应
对自身训练not足的信念削弱Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Strong fear and avoidance of lifting or assisting the elderly
antecedent: Specific tasks at the nursing home requiring lifting or assisting
Recalling the witnessed fall from a few months ago
意识到自己训练not如部分医务人员时
target_behavior.core_reason: 目睹摔倒事件后将风险普遍化并自我归责,伴随灾难化与'预测not yet来'的认知;对自身训练not足的Increasing worry失误Anticipation.
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在危险与责任以降低即时Anxiety,同时通过寻求同事安慰/接手来获得短暂的安全感
target_behavior.consequence: 志愿服务能力受影响,Relationship tension;在抬扶情境中出现明显生理Anxiety(心率加快,出汗),对其他活动的投入度下降
